review.notes: Full review of the unchanged head (same as r11). r11 R01, the pull-request description (README-only claim false, no order with #1330), is not repaired and is carried as R05. New P2 findings: R01, about twenty README targets in E0.3-E0.8, E1.1, E2.5 and E2.6 are already declared in the pinned Tau Ceti (fullEnhancedSubcategory, IsWeaklyContractible, SmallSpaceModel and IsLocallySmall, DGSimplicialCategory, IsCardinalFiltered, freeYonedaFunctor, sections over projective sheaves, Topos.IsLocallyWeaklyContractible, SimplicialObject.IsHypercover), each checked by #check at the pin, with the README Checks proved there; R02, Suggested.lean redefines TauCeti.valuationSaturationMap and IsValuationSaturated (equality proved in a probe) and restates TauCeti.exists_basis_of_isValuationSaturated (BS17 6.14); R03, MonoidalCategory.IsInvertible is planned both here and in EtaleCohomologyFoundations (#1891, README 1823-1824), which consumes EDS 0.1-0.4, so this roadmap should own it. P3: R04, roadmaps are cited for carriers Tau Ceti has (join, slice, right mapping space, core, Cartesian edges, qcqs topos objects, module derivedHom and derivedLimit); R06, the definitional-order paragraph states a symmetric monoidal equivalence for any ring, while HA 7.1.2.13 needs commutative rings; R07, the Check at README 876 uses R = 0, which CharP excludes; R08, the Stacks numbering convention at README 80. Checked: gate rerun OK (all zero); depcheck 238 roadmaps, 2368 edges, 0 problems; outside-folder diff empty; lake env lean on Suggested.lean exits 0 with 11 sorry warnings; #check @ of all 19 declarations (the 6 signature leads are false); 11 one-tactic padding probes, all failing; 241 of 308 backticked README names resolve at the pins (the rest are roadmap names, paths, expressions and short forms that resolve separately); 10 Tau Ceti modules built for the probe; supplier names resolved on main c58403c. Sources: the seeded sample 0.1-0.4 in the cache (HA 1.3.5.8/1.3.5.9/1.3.5.21, 4.1.7.4/4.1.7.6; Stacks 079P, 06YS, sites-cohomology sections 17-19 and 35, 0GMW/03EM/03EP, 08TB, 07KW/07KY/091D, 091V/0920/0G1U/0923), plus HA 7.1.1.16 and 7.1.2.13, BS17 (11.31-11.35, 6.14, 3.16), 23 BS-proet results and 15 Cohomology on Sites tags. A 32-row adversarial table with computed values, including a script computing the reflexive-pair comma category homology (13 objects, 40 arrows, H1 = Q^2) and the sharpness of perfect_projectiveDimension_le (pd R/J_t = 2). Ownership: roadmaps grep of the headline objects; HigherToposTheory #1901 overlaps but this roadmap on main is the earlier owner; #1187's copy equals main's.
